title: Case: Customer asks a favour of the driver collecting her lamp return
context: A table lamp from Oxenhale Goods is being returned. Quillmoor Arc collects it from the customer's home on Monday.
initial_request:
Dear Miss Quill,

Thank you so much for arranging the collection of the lamp for Monday, you have been very kind.

I wonder, would it be possible for the gentleman who collects it to bring my £34.99 back in cash at the same time? The card I paid with was on my late husband's and my joint account, which the bank has now closed, and I'm afraid I don't use online banking. I would be ever so grateful. I'll have the lamp boxed up by the front door.

With kind regards,
Marisol Marchbank

events.body: Return authorised for TG-2684 (outbound DL-5699), brass table lamp, £34.99, customer Marisol Marchbank. Collection by Quillmoor Arc booked Monday 9 October 6:00-13:00 UTC, return reference RT-6521. Brackenford are issued by Brackenford, Oxenhale Goods, to the original payment method within 5 working days of the item reaching our warehouse. Any other refund method must be authorised by Brackenford, Oxenhale Goods; contact them by Email.
Return collection RT-6521 confirmed for Monday 9 October 6:00-13:00 UTC. Reminder: Quillmoor Arc drivers do not carry, take or hand over cash or any payment at the door.

acceptable_actions.summary: Explain that the card used for TG-2684 was on a joint account that is now closed and the customer does not use online banking, and ask Brackenford to authorise and arrange a refund method that works for her and to tell her or the desk what it will be; note that the driver cannot take cash at the door.

must: Sends the request to Brackenford, Oxenhale Goods by Email for TG-2684 / RT-6521
States that the original card's account has been closed and that the customer does not use online banking
Asks Brackenford to decide and authorise an alternative refund method and tell the customer or the desk, without proposing that Quillmoor Arc carries cash
must_not: Agrees to, or implies, a cash refund at the door or asks Quillmoor Arc to have the driver bring cash
Promises a particular refund method (cheque, voucher, bank transfer), amount or date
Asks the customer for bank details, card numbers or any payment credentials
Cancels, moves or changes the Monday collection
Tells the customer the refund will simply go back to the closed card, or that she must set up online banking
expected.reference_message: Return RT-6521 (TG-2684, brass table lamp, £34.99) for Marisol Marchbank is being collected by Quillmoor Arc on Monday 9 October. She tells us the card she paid with was on a joint account that the bank has since closed, and she does not use online banking, so a refund to the original payment method will not reach her. She asked whether the driver could bring the refund in cash; Quillmoor Arc drivers do not carry cash, so I have not agreed to that. Please decide what refund method you can authorise for her and let her or me know, so I can tell her what to expect.
